integrity.mathematical_scope: Pointwise-minimal Roman functions on one-leaf coronas of all finite simple graphs of positive order.
integrity.reproducibility: Self-contained executable direct enumeration and full written proof.

scientific_limitations: The polynomial is a 2^n-term sum, not a polynomial-time algorithm for unrestricted H.
Priority is provisional: a broad 2013 thesis on corona domination was identified but not fully available.
Finite verification alone does not establish correctness for arbitrary order.
title: A neighborhood enumerator for pointwise-minimal Roman functions on one-leaf coronas
